criteria.criterion: Apple uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries
required_elements: the cobalt is in all Apple-designed batteries
criteria.promise_scope: Apple promised that by 2025 it would use 100 percent recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries; beneficiaries/location are unspecified because this is a company-wide product-material commitment rather than a site-specific or population-specific pledge.
criteria.observed_scope: “As part of this work, Apple now uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all the batteries it designs and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets.” “Today, all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt, and all magnets are made with 100 percent recycled rare earth elements.” “Apple also reached several targets for recycled content in select components last year.”
criteria.explanation: The cited sources document the terms of the undertaking.
criteria.gap: The excerpts do not tie an observed occurrence to the promised scope.

occurrence_witness.action_quote: all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt

entailment_check.incomplete_delivery_alternative: The cited evidence says this is true "Today" and that Apple reached several targets "last year," but it does not explicitly state when during 2025 all Apple-designed batteries had already reached 100 percent recycled cobalt, so full delivery by the original 2025 deadline could still have been missed if this was achieved only after 2025 ended.
entailment_check.observed_fact: Apple states that today all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt, and it also says it reached several recycled-content targets last year.

trace.label: UNVERIFIED
trace.verdict: The available evidence does not establish delivery of the requested obligation.
